job.title: Electrical Applications Engineer Co-Op 2026
job.description: The Student Program at Nexteer Automotive offers high potential students meaningful opportunities to apply classroom learning in a professional environment while gaining hands on experience and valuable industry exposure. Learn more about our student program and career opportunities at Nexteer by visiting www.nexteer.com/careers . In This Role You Will: Assist in Electrical Power Steering (EPS) system and software development which includes, but is not limited to, the following activities. Software and calibration update activities to support customer samples, vehicle testing, validation, and production. Assist in EPS trouble shooting activities using CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe, oscilloscopes, and custom-made software tools like eTool, eCalNet. Assist in updates to requirements as a part of the development lifecycle. Assist in the creation of DFMEAs, Design Reviews, and validation plans. Assist with analysis and communication regarding defects, software changes, samples, validation updates, and much more. Assist in the creation and testing of Controller Assembly specifications. Attend Internal Product Development Team meetings. Assist in the creation of electrical harnesses and connectors for controllers. Job Requirements: Candidate must be attending a 2-year college or 4-year university local to Saginaw. Candidate must be pursuing a bachelor’s in electrical engineering or computer science​ Candidate must have a cumulative 2.7 GPA on a 4.0 scale Candidate must have the ability to work 20-32 hours per week during the Fall and Winter semesters and up to 40 hours in the summer Candidate must be a full-time student (12 or more credits) during Fall and Winter semesters Candidate must have right to work in the US and not require current or future sponsorship Candidate must be proficient with Microsoft Operating Systems and Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook). Candidate should be highly motivated with strong communication skills and a desire to work with people in a fast-paced environment Preferred Experience: Experience performing engineering calculations using MATLAB/Simulink and Microsoft Excel Programming experience using C, C#, or Visual Basic Familiarity with Vector Communication tools that apply to CAN networks (CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe) Fundamental understanding of the engineering development V model Fundamental understanding of vehicle dynamics, mechanical systems, electronic systems, and computer hardware and software Equal Opportunity Employer Disabled/Minorities/Veterans/Women VEVRAA Federal Contractor Nexteer is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an internet based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA) that allows participating employees to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States. Accessibility for Applicants with Disabilities: If you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability please call 1-989-757-5000 . Please provide your contact information and details about the posted position of interest. Only inquiries regarding assistance for those who need an accommodation with the online application process due to a disability will be returned.
